messages:
Priya: Quick thread to capture launch blockers for the private deploy networking work. We need a short, ship-ready checklist for VPC & on-prem customers. What are absolute must-haves vs stretch goals?

Liam: Must-haves from sales/CS: preserved customer egress IP per tenant, deterministic source IPs for audit, and installer preflight that flags overlap or route conflicts. Customers told us they will not accept opaque SNAT behavior.

Jorge: Technical constraints: on-prem customers want a way to bring their own IPs and for the operator to assert ownership without a full IPAM integration. I recommend a small contract: a JSON/YAML mapping the tenant -> egress IP(s) + optional next_hop. Keep it file-driven for v1.

Nina: From reliability: require an upgrade plan that supports incremental rollouts and automated rollback if health checks fail. Rollback target: restore traffic to previous model within 3 minutes for an individual tenant, 10 minutes for cluster-level rollback.

Priya: Good. We should formalize acceptance criteria in the PRD: 1) egress IP preservation, 2) installer preflight + conflict fail, 3) per-tenant canary rollout, 4) operator mapping contract and docs, 5) telemetry for routing changes (audit logs). Anything else?

Liam: Add: docs for network operators showing required firewall rules and a troubleshooting playbook. Field asks keep it simple: 2-3 kb quickstart and a longer troubleshoot doc.

Jorge: Implementation note: sample mapping format:
```
tenants:
  - id: tenant-42
    egress_ips: [198.51.100.12]
    allowed_prefixes: [10.10.0.0/16]
    next_hop: 192.0.2.1
```
Installer will validate no duplicate egress across tenants and ensure no overlap with host control-plane IPs.

Nina: Ops metric wishlist: routing-change events (who/what/when), per-tenant latency delta after routing switch, and conflict detection rate during install. Tie these into console so CS can triage.

Priya: Timeline ask: can we get an RFC by next Tue and a minimal prototype for the installer validation + operator mapping by end of sprint? We'll present to Sales on Wed.

Jorge: I can have the RFC draft and sample controller by Monday EOD. Prototype for the installer validation (dry-run) by Friday.

Liam: CS will collect 3 customer confirmation signoffs for acceptance criteria (one enterprise, two mid-market) and populate the PRD.

ops-bot: Ticket created: PROJ-788 "Private deploy: Customer IP contract + installer preflight" assigned to Jorge, due 1765420000.

Priya: Perfect. I'll add acceptance criteria + docs tasks to the roadmap board and flag dependencies (installer, console events, docs). If blockers surface, escalate to Eng PMs. Thanks all. :raised_hands:
